name: Modern Ark Pharm Cafe
desc: A vegetarian organic cafe that also serves alcohol and desserts.

name: Naruto Taiyaki Honpo Hankyu Sannomiya-ekimae
desc: A cramped and popular taiyaki shop. Serves 2 varieties of taiyaki, a fish-shaped cake: sweet potato and red bean paste.

name: Ryukaso
desc: Chinese restaurant. Try the chicken.

name: Grill Ippei
desc: Specializes in yōshoku, or Japanized Western dishes. Specialities include Ebi furai (breaded shrimp), kaki furai (breaded oyster), hamburger steaks and tonkatsu (pork cutlets).

name: Torikizoku
desc: Torikizoku is the most popular yakitori chain in Kansai. The Yakitori is delicious, comes in generous serves and is very cheap. It's very popular with both locals and expats, and is always busy. Try to come before 7:30PM

name: Cafe Terrasse de Paris
desc: A French restaurant with a romantic view.

name: Kobe Beef Steak Ishida Kitanozaka
desc: Rated one of the best places for Kobe beef.

name: Kobe Portopia Hotel Restaurants
desc: There are several restaurants in the Kobe Portopia Hotel, some with high floor views.

name: Kokubu
desc: One of the top Kobe beef steakhouses.

name: Medium Rare Steakhouse @ Oriental Hotel
desc: Great Kobe Beef, Hida Beef, Hamburg Steak, Abalone, and Fresh Japanese Tiger Prawns. All perfectly cooked right in front of you on Teppan grills to your liking.

name: Mouriya
addr: Daiichi Kishi Bldg. 3F, 9-9 1-chome, Kitanagasa Dori, Chuo-ku
desc: One of the most famous houses serving Kobe beef. The slightly reduced lunch specials are worth checking out. Must make reservations.

name: Wakkoqu @ Shin-Kobe
desc: Kobe beef prepared right in front of you.

name: Chicken George
desc: One of the most famous places with live music in Japan.

name: Hub
desc: A basement location of the British pub chain. Happy hour discount cocktails 17:00-19:00.

name: New Muenchen Kobe Taishikan
desc: Serves seasonal brews and dishes as well as the timeless favorites of German and Japanese beer halls. Bar service on ground floor, table service on higher floors. Capacity 540.

name: Sone
desc: An excellent place to relax with a drink, Sone also happens to be one of the best jazz clubs in Kansai. You will have to pay a cover charge on a night with big names performing.

name: The Rock
desc: An Aussie Bar and Grill popular with expats and locals alike. Shisha can also be provided.

name: Cafe Freundlieb
desc: A cafe in a former church.

name: Eden

name: Cafe NADI
addr: New Kobe Building 2F, 7-21 Shoraisho (松籟荘7-21 ニューコーベビル2F)
desc: Closed every Tuesday. Indonesian and Asian food restaurant owned by a Japanese wife and an Indonesian husband often dressed in Balinese attire. Small restaurant but has a nice and cozy atmosphere. Nasi Goreng and Mie Gor

name: Gontaro Sushi
desc: A small sushi bar just north of Nishinomiya-Kitaguchi Station on the Hankyu line. An English menu is available and they are great for the price! 15 seats.
